Participants must adhere to the general competition rules of "Where Winds Meet." For details, please refer to the [General Competition Rules] section on the official website's competition center.

The "Wind and Thunder Tournament" adopts a fair balancing mode. Rangers can freely combine Martial Styles, Inner Ways, and Mystic Skills, with stats unaffected by character progression (characters use unified fixed stats: Martial Styles at Lv. 95, Inner Ways at Tier 6, and Mystic Skills at Tier 6 Stage 9. Equipment sets, tuning, and resonance effects are disabled). After the challenge begins, players can switch Martial Style combinations and Artifacts during the preparation phase.

In the preliminary rounds, Rangers must sequentially challenge 3 designated bosses ("Coffin Master," "Nameless General," and "Yi Dao"). Each boss offers 3 attempts. The next boss is unlocked only after completing all attempts for the current one. The shortest completion time among the 3 attempts is recorded as the best score for that boss, and the two Martial Styles used for that score will be locked and cannot be reused in subsequent challenges. The final total score is the sum of the best times for all three bosses.

In the elimination rounds, Rangers must consecutively challenge 3 fixed bosses ("Coffin Master," "Nameless General," and "Yi Dao"). Health and consumable quantities carry over without resetting within a single attempt, and entirely different Martial Styles must be used for each boss (restricted only within a single attempt). During the preparation phase for each boss, players can switch Martial Styles and Artifacts via training and inventory. There are 3 attempts in total, with the shortest time recorded as the final score.

The finals follow the same rules as the elimination rounds, with the last boss announced on the day of the finals.
